finalResult.nextParagraphText: He still had a lot of things to think about, it seemed, including the other more casual relationships in his life. Jake had been born and raised on Earth in a culture where monogamy was the only socially acceptable norm, and shedding that norm wouldn’t be easy, assuming it was even something he wanted to do.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: Jake continued to listen as he let out a loud sigh after the Viper was done.
